qr.sql:
SELECT
                d.id,
                d.product_id,
                d.warehouse_id,
                d.status
            FROM sasms.devices d
            JOIN sasms.warehouses w
                ON w.id = d.warehouse_id
            WHERE d.qr_token = CAST(? AS uuid)
              AND sasms.has_permission(
                  CAST(? AS uuid),
                  'inventory.read',
                  w.store_id
              ) = TRUE

ai_stock.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.list_price, sa.available, c.name AS category_name
            FROM sasms.products p
            JOIN sasms.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
            JOIN sasms.stock_availability sa
                 ON sa.product_id = p.id AND sa.warehouse_id = CAST(? AS uuid)
            WHERE p.sku = ANY (CAST(? AS text[]))
              AND p.is_active = TRUE
              AND sa.available > 0
            ORDER BY p.sku ASC

bi_summary.sql:
SELECT
              COALESCE((SELECT sum(o.total_amount) FROM sasms.sales_orders o
                WHERE o.store_id=CAST(? AS uuid) AND o.status='PAID' AND o.paid_at>=? AND o.paid_at<?),0) gross,
              (SELECT count(*) FROM sasms.sales_orders o
                WHERE o.store_id=CAST(? AS uuid) AND o.status='PAID' AND o.paid_at>=? AND o.paid_at<?) paid_orders,
              (SELECT count(*) FROM sasms.devices d JOIN sasms.warehouses w ON w.id=d.warehouse_id
                WHERE w.store_id=CAST(? AS uuid) AND d.status='IN_STOCK') available_devices,
              (SELECT count(*) FROM sasms.inventory_movements m JOIN sasms.warehouses w ON w.id=m.warehouse_id
                WHERE w.store_id=CAST(? AS uuid) AND m.kind='RECEIVE' AND m.created_at>=? AND m.created_at<?) received,
              (SELECT count(*) FROM sasms.inventory_movements m JOIN sasms.warehouses w ON w.id=m.warehouse_id
                WHERE w.store_id=CAST(? AS uuid) AND m.kind='SALE' AND m.created_at>=? AND m.created_at<?) sold,
              (SELECT count(*) FROM sasms.inventory_movements m JOIN sasms.warehouses w ON w.id=m.warehouse_id
                WHERE w.store_id=CAST(? AS uuid) AND m.kind='RETURN' AND m.created_at>=? AND m.created_at<?) returned

inventory_stock.sql:
SELECT
                sa.product_id,
                sa.warehouse_id,
                sa.available + sa.reserved AS accounting_stock,
                sa.available AS sellable_count,
                sa.reserved AS reserved_count
            FROM sasms.stock_availability sa
            JOIN sasms.warehouses w ON w.id = sa.warehouse_id
            JOIN sasms.products p ON p.id = sa.product_id
            WHERE sasms.has_permission(
                    CAST(? AS uuid),
                    'inventory.read',
                    w.store_id
                  ) = TRUE
              AND (CAST(? AS uuid) IS NULL OR sa.warehouse_id = CAST(? AS uuid))
              AND (CAST(? AS text) IS NULL OR p.sku ILIKE ('%' || CAST(? AS text) || '%'))
            ORDER BY p.sku ASC, sa.warehouse_id ASC
            LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
